scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; finite standard-library checks are diagnostic only. Novelty comparisons include full 2026 motivating manuscript, two full published comparison results and available 2025 abstract. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple undirected unweighted regular graph; exactly two RKL2 stages and unit edge rates. Triangular graph J(n,2) for n>=4; no higher-stage, nonregular, or accuracy guarantee. Closely related 2025 full text was not accessible.
title: A sharp spectral-to-positivity gap for two-stage RKL2 heat flow on triangular graphs
